mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in FEDFUNDS over the past 3 months signals an easing monetary cycle, compressing discount rates and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns despite sustained FEDFUNDS decline over the next 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in UNRATE above 6% triggers a labor market weakening, reducing consumer spending and corporate investment, which drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns positive despite UNRATE crossing above 6% in the prior 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in GDPC1 (demand growth) and decline in FEDFUNDS (monetary easing) creates a synergistic effect, amplifying equity valuation growth and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 falls while FEDFUNDS rises, leading to negative returns despite the initial signal.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, rising INDPRO (supply growth) reduces inflationary pressures, enabling central banks to maintain lower interest rates and fostering positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns negative despite INDPRO rising in a late-cycle expansion regime.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in FEDFUNDS above 4.5% signals tightening monetary policy, raising borrowing costs and dampening equity valuations, which drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS remains above 4.5% but SPX returns positive.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained growth in PAYEMS (employment) reflects a strengthening labor market, boosting consumer confidence and corporate investment, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS growth stalls or reverses, leading to negative returns despite initial positive trends.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent rises in GDPC1 (demand growth) and HOUST (demand activity) create a reinforcing cycle, driving up corporate earnings and equity prices, which generates positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 falls while HOUST rises, resulting in negative returns despite the initial signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in INDPRO below 95 signals reduced supply-side activity, increasing inflationary pressures and prompting interest rate hikes, which drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO remains below 95 but SPX returns positive.
